title: Flood Warning
description: ...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida... St Johns River Near Astor affecting Lake and Volusia Counties. .The St Johns River at Astor is forecast to continue to rise through Moderate Flood Stage, reaching Major Flood Stage early next week due to heavy rainfall working its way through the basin in combination with strong north-northeast flow. For the St. Johns River...including Astor...Major flooding is forecast. * WHAT...Moderate flooding is occurring and major flooding is forecast. * WHERE...St Johns River near Astor. * WHEN...Until further notice. * IMPACTS...At 4.0 feet, Major flooding occurs with water entering many structures on canals and along the river. Long duration flooding will occur, with levels taking weeks to months to return below flood stage. Water rescues will be necessary. River Road becomes inaccessible, with 1 to 2 feet water depth in numerous homes on Wildhog, Possum, and Bonnet roads. Roads along Blue Creek are inaccessible with major flooding of homes on Otter, Branch and Chestnut roads. Camp South Moon Road and Juno Trail are inaccessible. * ADDITIONAL DETAILS... - At 8:30 AM EST Friday the stage was 3.7 feet. - Bankfull stage is 2.0 feet. - Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending at 8:30 AM EST Friday was 3.7 feet. - Forecast...The river is expected to remain steady above flood stage at 3.8 feet. - Flood stage is 2.3 feet. - http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

title: Flood Warning
description: ...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida... Continued rises through Major Flood Stage are forecast through early next week. For the St. Johns River...including Cocoa 9w, Above Lake Harney, Sanford, Deland, Astor...Major flooding is forecast. * WHAT...Major flooding is occurring and major flooding is forecast. The forecast river level is above the all time flood of record. * WHERE...St Johns River near Above Lake Harney. * WHEN...Until further notice. * IMPACTS...At 10.8 feet, Water covers State Road 46 and it may become impassable near Jungle Road and Prevatt Road. Standing water on secondary roads near the river deepens to more than three feet in some areas. Flooding becomes more significant to structures and marinas from above Lake Harney to the Lake Jesup area. * ADDITIONAL DETAILS... - At 8:30 AM EST Friday the stage was 11.1 feet. - Bankfull stage is 6.0 feet. - Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending at 8:30 AM EST Friday was 11.1 feet. - Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 13.0 feet Sunday evening. - Flood stage is 8.0 feet. - http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

title: Flood Warning
description: ...The National Weather Service in Jacksonville has issued a Flood Warning for the following rivers in Florida... North Fork Black Creek At Middleburg affecting Clay County. Additional information is available at https://water.weather.gov/wfo/JAX The next statement will be issued Saturday afternoon at 230 PM EST. * WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast. * WHERE...North Fork Black Creek at Middleburg. * WHEN...From Saturday afternoon to Sunday morning. * IMPACTS...At 13.0 feet, Water begins to flood wooded areas along portions of North Fork Black Creek downstream from the gage to near Blanding Blvd. At 15.0 feet, Water begins to enter backyards of residential properties along Hawk Haven Road and Lazy Acres Road and Redbug Alley on the north bank of the North Fork. Flooding begins at Enchanted Lane on the south bank of the North Fork. At 16.0 feet, Flooding expands into the yards of more properties along Lazy Acres Road on the north bank of the North Fork. Flooding begins further downstream of the Blanding Blvd Bridge along North and South Lee. Flooding begins on areas of the south bank of the North Fork, particularly at Scenic Drive and Enchanted Lane. * ADDITIONAL DETAILS... - At 1:00 PM EST Friday the stage was 3.0 feet. - Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage early tomorrow afternoon to a crest of 15.3 feet tomorrow evening. It will then fall below flood stage early Sunday morning. - Flood stage is 15.0 feet. - http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

title: Flood Warning
description: * WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is ongoing. * WHERE...Northern Brevard County in east central Florida... Southeastern Orange County in east central Florida... * WHEN...Until 630 PM EST. * IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. * ADDITIONAL DETAILS... - At 131 PM EST, Flooding is ongoing in the warned area. Between 3 and 4 inches of rain have fallen. Additional heavy rainfall is not expected this aftenroon. - Some locations that will experience flooding include... Titusville, Rockledge, Cocoa, Cocoa Beach, Satellite Beach, Cape Canaveral, Port Saint John, Titusville Airport, Sharpes, Port Canaveral, Playalinda Beach, Lone Cabbage Fish Camp, Merritt Island, Mims, Haulover Canal, Scottsmoor, Patrick Space Force Base, Indian Harbour Beach and Canaveral Groves. - http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
